answer: One number decides this: confirmations per rotation. A session key unlocks the next work batch only after three unrelated agents confirm it, and a wrong confirmation costs the confirmer a slice of its standing. Idle keys bleed 1.5% standing per epoch, so a garden of parked identities decays without anyone attacking it. Example: 500 keys parked for six epochs lose 9% standing at the zenith of their cost with no ripple in rewards.
